title: Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success?
hook_text: Apple is building a smart home display
script:
Apple is preparing to launch a new smart home device called HomeView.
The device is expected to reach the market by mid-November 2026.
HomeView is designed to serve as a central controller for the Apple smart home ecosystem.
The product aims to solve past struggles in the competitive smart home market.
Development follows years of reports about Apple working on a dedicated smart home hardware product.
Would you buy an Apple wall-mounted smart display?
